dataset: UCI Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic), repository ID 17
attribution: Wolberg, W., Mangasarian, O., Street, N., and Street, W. (1993). Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic). UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5DW2B

license.scope: Source dataset and adapted data retain CC-BY-4.0 attribution. Software MIT licensing does not replace the data attribution.

scope: Real source FNA nuclear numeric measurements and M/B diagnosis, not radiomics extracted by this engine. Source IDs identify records; no longitudinal patient linkage is supplied or inferred.

protocol.split_method: within each original diagnosis, sort by (SHA256(UTF8(namespace + source_id)), source_id); first floor(0.8*n_class) records train, rest test
protocol.group_identity: one source record ID per group, not independently verified clinical patient linkage
protocol.numeric_features: all 30 source measurements in declared order; no ID or diagnosis predictor
protocol.test_use: held-out evaluation only; never parameter/feature/threshold selection; remove diagnosis for saved-model prediction while retaining test cohort identity
